hero.subtitle: The Anti-OS: Universal Sync Orchestrator (USO). Unify software, AI agents, and enterprise platforms into one governed command surface. Every action is authorized, logged, and reversible.
hero.description: OmniDash keeps execution in view. Single-plane. Modal-first. PiP persistent. One-hand ready. Translate across English, French, Spanish, German, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese (en-US, fr-FR, es-ES, de-DE, ja-JP, zh-CN). OmniHub is the Brain. OmniDash is the Eyes. PhysiOmni is the Hands and Feet (Enterprise). APEX Agent is the Voice. OmniLink is the AppShell.
